reassessment: Whole-blob hashes were too restrictive: 124 complete runtime programs match exact slices at offsets 0,64,128,192. This is not evidence of corrupt shaders.
Index-prefix-only attribution was incomplete. Analysis now also requires the matching primary vertex-buffer prefix and pixel shader material reference; ambiguous candidates are excluded.
Repeated rigid instances are separated by recorded model transform; world-space vertices ignore unused model constants.
Texture-register hash changes include unused fetch slots and cannot establish a changed sampled texture.
Stable c210-c212 values cover only those registers, not all lighting or GPU texture contents.
Projection using source rigid/world conventions places envelope meshes 183 and 184 in the upper/right view. This is a candidate localization, not yet proof that either is the circled surface.
The trace does not contain output pixels, per-frame GPU texture contents, or a marker identifying the exact black frame. Root cause remains unproven.
